ON MY RADAR 11.20.26

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:43
Instaread

This post may contain affiliate links. If you purchase through these links, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you.

I’m mentally preparing myself for decorating for Christmas once we get through Thanksgiving. We usually wait to get our tree until that weekend after and then I kick everyone out of our house and try to get as much decorating done as possible 🤣I know most of my stuff is NOT organized in storage though… and the thought of pulling everything out and setting it up isn’t sounding appealing to me at the moment. I know I’ll be happy and cozy and festive when it’s all up but until then, I’m feeling like a grinch!

On My Radar

ONE // Winter Stroll Scented Tassel

This is so, so genius. A scented tassel! Tuckernuck sent it to me as a holiday gift and when I first opened it, I thought it was just a decorative tassel. Cute! But… then when I moved it, I smelled a wonderful winter scent! It would be the perfect hostess gift for holiday parties.

TWO // The Sea: A Love Story

Some fun book news! If you’re a fan of Sophie Blackall’s children’s books (Hello Lighthouse is a staple in our house), you’ll be as thrilled as I am to hear that she wrote an illustrated memoir! Told through 24 stories, it’s a totally unique memoir. Ann Patchett even blurbed it: “The Sea is a voyage into the past, into history and science, into loss and love, into the world that lies beneath the water and the world that soars above it. This is a journey both beautiful and profound. Sophie Blackall is a genius.”

THREE // The Nightingale Trailer

Our first look at Dakota and Elle Fanning’s The Nightingale is here! This is one of the most anticipated book-to-movie adaptations. After a bunch of delays, I thought it would never happen! I’m so excited to see Dakota and Elle on screen together, too. I think I may even reread the book, it’s been a decade since I read it… 

FOUR // Gorgeous Essay on Motherhood

This TikTok video stopped me in my tracks. I was not prepared for how much it was going to emotionally wreck me. Watch at your own risk 😉

FIVE // 30% Off Ring Concierge

I wanted to call out what I think is one of the best sales of the season: Ring Concierge! Everything is 30% off! My two favorite pieces: the jumbo huggies & the studs. Both are *perfection* for everyday wear. I’ve tried other brands with lab grown diamonds and haven’t been nearly as impressed as I am with Ring Concierge. The quality is top notch. I think I’m going to get these charms for the huggies (brilliant) and I got the tennis drop earrings!
